title: Mutual-aid gang arrival times are not captured
detail: Two mutual-aid gangs were requested from neighbouring circles and both worked the event, but neither crew record carries a mobilisation time, so mutual-aid gang-hours cannot be computed from the records.

title: Time to first consumer notification exceeded the two-hour target
detail: The first outage was recorded at 16:52 and the first consumer notification was issued at 19:33, an interval of 2 hours 41 minutes against a two-hour internal target.

title: Outage management system link was lost with no fallback capture
detail: The link to the Asansol data centre was unavailable for 3 hours 30 minutes and no manual consumer counts were taken during the gap, leaving a hole in the restoration curve that cannot be reconstructed.
